entries.notes: Nova-3 Multilingual streaming, pay-as-you-go. This is a limited-time promotional rate on the pricing page (regular streaming rate shown struck through: 0.0092/min). Multichannel is billed per channel: the Deepgram FAQ says a 10-minute stereo file is billed as 20 minutes, so usage is recorded in channel-seconds (both channels summed) and priced as-is.

Nova-3 Monolingual streaming, pay-as-you-go, limited-time promotional rate (regular 0.0077/min). Used when the session language is a single language (vi/en) rather than 'multi'. Per-channel billing as above.
Nova-3 Multilingual pre-recorded, pay-as-you-go. Multichannel billed per channel.
Nova-3 Monolingual pre-recorded, pay-as-you-go. Multichannel billed per channel.

Universal-3.6 Pro streaming, $0.45/hour = 0.0075/min, billed per connection (session) second, not per audio channel. The provider opens one mono socket per channel, so usage is recorded as socket-seconds (both channels summed) and priced as-is. Idle open sessions are billed too; sockets are closed promptly.
Standard paid tier, text input. Output price includes thinking tokens, so output tokens = candidates + thoughts. Audio input (0.50) is not used.
Standard tier. Cached-input discounts are not modelled (cost is an upper estimate).
Standard tier. Cached-input discounts are not modelled (cost is an upper estimate).
